title: Preservation of filtered environmental DNA samples at ambient high temperatures
author: Matsumura, Wu, et al.
materials: DNA extraction from Sterivex cartridges followed the Buffer ATL-based method described by Wu and Minamoto [15] using the DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (Qiagen). For Sterivex cartridges without ATL, 1 mL ATL was added at this stage. Then, 1 mL of lysis mixture (495 µL 1 × PBS, 455 µL Buffer AL, 50 µL Proteinase K) was added to each cartridge and incubated at 56 °C for 30 min. After incubation, cartridges were centrifuged at 6000 × g for 3 min, and 1 mL ethanol was added to the eluate and mixed thoroughly. The solution was transferred to DNeasy columns in ∼650 µL aliquots and centrifuged at 6000 × g for 1 min. Flow-through was discarded, and the column was reloaded with remaining solution until all liquid passed through. DNA was then purified following the DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit protocol and eluted in 150 µL Buffer AE.

steps.title: Collect water and add BAC
steps.instruction: Collect the required volume of environmental water in a 1000 mL spout pouch (COWPACK). For tank samples add 12 mL of 10 % benzalkonium chloride (BAC) solution to 12 L water (or 10 mL of 10 % BAC to each 10 L tank for river samples); for field blanks add the same amount of BAC to 500 mL purified water. Mix thoroughly to distribute the BAC.

steps.title: Assemble filtration apparatus
steps.instruction: Connect the Nipro tube to the spout pouch, secure with a 150 mm cable tie, and attach Luer fitting VRM306 (AS ONE) to the tube inlet. Connect the other end of the tube to the inlet of a 0.45 µm Sterivex cartridge (Merck) using Luer fitting VRM306. Seal the spout pouch with a cream double‑cap W‑16 (Kenis) and hang the pouch using cable ties/S‑hooks. Attach outlet Luer fittings (VPRM406 and VRF306, AS ONE) and vinyl hose (3 × 5 mm) as shown in the material list. Cap the Sterivex outlet with Luer fitting VRSP6 (AS ONE).

steps.title: Gravity‑filter 500 mL water
steps.instruction: Place the assembled spout pouch about 2 m above ground inside a plastic bag. Pour 500 mL of the collected water into the pouch and allow gravity to pull the water through the Sterivex cartridge. Continue filtration until the pouch is empty (maximum 24 h).

steps.title: Add ATL preservative
steps.instruction: Using a dropper, inject 1 mL Buffer ATL (Qiagen) into each Sterivex cartridge designated for preservation. Leave the remaining cartridges without ATL (they will receive ATL later during extraction).

steps.title: Post‑filtration storage
steps.instruction: Store the cartridges under the following conditions: (a) immediately freeze (0 h), (b) 20 °C for 10 h, (c) 20 °C for 1 week, (d) 40 °C for 10 h, (e) 40 °C for 1 week. After the prescribed storage period, keep all cartridges at –25 °C until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract DNA from Sterivex cartridges
steps.instruction: For cartridges that did not receive ATL earlier, add 1 mL ATL now. Then add 1 mL lysis mixture consisting of 495 µL 1 × PBS, 455 µL Buffer AL, and 50 µL Proteinase K (Qiagen). Incubate the cartridge at 56 °C for 30 min. Centrifuge at 6000 × g for 3 min. Add 1 mL ethanol to the eluate and mix thoroughly. Transfer the mixture to DNeasy spin columns in ~650 µL aliquots, centrifuge each aliquot at 6000 × g for 1 min, discarding flow‑through each time, and reload until all liquid has passed through the column. Continue with the DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit protocol and elute DNA in 150 µL Buffer AE.

substeps.instruction: Add ATL if not already added (1 mL).
Add lysis mixture (495 µL PBS, 455 µL Buffer AL, 50 µL Proteinase K).
Load onto DNeasy column in ~650 µL portions, centrifuge 6000 × g, 1 min each, discard flow‑through, repeat until all liquid processed.
Purify according to kit instructions and elute in 150 µL Buffer AE.
